skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the economic activities and management of urban areas.
Evaluate strengths and weaknesses, identify issues in urban economic and management activities.
Apply research methods to analyze and solve urban economic and management issues.
Work independently and in teams to solve assigned tasks.
Collect, analyze, synthesize, and evaluate data to address practical management issues.
Propose solutions to urban economic and management issues.
Adapt to changes in organizational and urban management environments.
Manage time effectively and complete tasks within deadlines.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and solve urban economic and management problems.
Write comprehensive and logical reports on urban economic and management issues.

prerequisite_courses: 75% of the program's credit hours must be completed
